blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks rebounded on Monday after last week’s steep sell-off, but the benchmark index failed to hold above 5,400 as trading remained light. The Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) rose 0.87 percent, or 46.09 points, to close at 5,353.07 after touching an intraday high of 5,419.49. READ: ICTSI sell-off drags PSEi to 6-year low The broader All Shares index gained 0.24 percent. Philstocks Financial Inc. described the gain as a technical bounce.
